people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
translations.bsb: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah. He will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense
translations.asv: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
